description: This file defines a utility class 'SplitTimer' for measuring CPU time and wall-clock time splits within an Android environment, primarily used for performance timing in the TensorFlow project.

classes.name: SplitTimer
classes.description: A utility class for timing CPU and wall-clock splits during program execution.

methods.name: SplitTimer
methods.description: Constructor initializes the timer with a given name and starts a new split.

methods.name: newSplit
methods.description: Resets the timer measurements for a new timing split.

methods.name: endSplit
methods.description: Calculates and logs the CPU and wall-clock time elapsed since the last split, with a given split name.
